User(Base):\n    __tablename__ = \"users\"\n\n    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True)\n    username = Column(String, unique=True, nullable=False)\n    full_name = Column(String)\n    email = Column(String, unique=True)\n    created_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)\n    updated_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)\n\nclass Animal(Base):\n    __tablename__ = \"animals\"\n\n    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True)\n    name = Column(String, nullable=False)\n    species = Column(String, nullable=False)\n    breed = Column(String)\n    age_years = Column(Integer)\n    microchip = Column(String, unique=True)\n    created_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)\n    updated_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)\n\nclass Intake(Base):\n    __tablename__ = \"intakes\"\n\n    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True)\n    intake_number = Column(String, unique=True, nullable=False)\n    animal_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey(\"animals.id\"), nullable=False)\n    intake_date = Column(DateTime, nullable=False)\n    status = Column(String, nullable=False, default=\"active\", check_constraint=CheckConstraint(\"status IN ('active','voided','completed','transferred')\"))\n    voided_reason = Column(Text)\n    voided_at = Column(DateTime)\n    voided_by_user_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey(\"users.id\"))\n    duplicate_of_intake_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey(\"intakes.id\"))\n    created_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)\n    updated_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)\n\n    __table_args__ = (\n        CheckConstraint(\"status IN ('active','voided','completed','transferred')\", name=\"check_status\"),\n    )\n\nclass MedicalEvent(Base):\n    __tablename__ = \"medical_events\"\n\n    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True)\n    intake_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey(\"intakes.id\"), nullable=False)\n    event_type = Column(String, nullable=False)\n    description = Column(Text)\n    event_date = Column(DateTime, nullable=False)\n    created_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)\n    updated_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)\n\nclass FosterPlacement(Base):\n    __tablename__ = \"foster_placements\"\n\n    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True)\n    placement_number = Column(String, unique=True, nullable=False)\n    intake_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey(\"intakes.id\"), nullable=False)\n    foster_user_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey(\"users.id\"))\n    start_date = Column(DateTime, nullable=False)\n    end_date = Column(DateTime)\n    status = Column(String, nullable=False, default=\"active\", check_constraint=CheckConstraint(\"status IN ('active','completed','cancelled')\"))\n    created_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)\n    updated_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)\n\n    __table_args__ = (\n        CheckConstraint(\"status IN ('active','completed','cancelled')\", name=\"check_status\"),\n    )\n\nclass AuditLog(Base):\n    __tablename__ = \"audit_log\"\n\n    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True)\n    user_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey(\"users.id\"), nullable=False)\n    action = Column(String, nullable=False)\n    entity_type = Column(String, nullable=False)\n    entity_id = Column(Integer, nullable=False)\n    details = Column(Text)\n    created_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)"

      "path": "schemas.py",
      "content": "from pydantic import BaseModel, Field\nfrom typing import Optional\nfrom datetime import datetime\n\n\nclass VoidDuplicateIntakeRequest(BaseModel):\n    target_intake_id: int = Field(..., description=\"ID of the intake that this one is a duplicate of\")\n    voided_reason: str = Field(..., description=\"Reason for voiding the intake\")\n\n\nclass VoidDuplicateIntakeResponse(BaseModel):\n    message: str\n    voided_intake_id: int\n    reassigned_medical_events_count: int\n    reassigned_foster_placements_count: int\n\n    model_config = {'from_attributes': True}"

    {
      "path": "routers/group_001.py",
      "content": "from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, status\nfrom sqlalchemy.orm import Session\nfrom database import SessionLocal, get_db\nfrom models import Intake, MedicalEvent, FosterPlacement, AuditLog, User\nfrom schemas import VoidDuplicateIntakeRequest, VoidDuplicateIntakeResponse\n\nrouter = APIRouter(tags=[\"Intakes\"])\n\n\n@router.patch(\n    \"/api/intakes/{intake_id}/void\",\n    operation_id=\"void_duplicate_intake\",\n    response_model=VoidDuplicateIntakeResponse\n)\nasync def void_duplicate_intake(\n    intake_id: int,\n    payload: VoidDuplicateIntakeRequest,\n    db: Session = Depends(get_db),\n    current_user: User = Depends(lambda: None)  # Placeholder for auth\n):\n    # Fetch the intake to be voided\n    voided_intake = db.query(Intake).filter(Intake.id == intake_id).first()\n    if not voided_intake:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, detail=\"Intake to be voided not found\")\n    \n    if voided_intake.status != \"active\":\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST, detail=\"Only active intakes can be voided\")\n    \n    # Fetch the target intake\n    target_intake = db.query(Intake).filter(Intake.id == payload.target_intake_id).first()\n    if not target_intake:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, detail=\"Target intake not found\")\n    \n    if target_intake.status != \"active\":\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST, detail=\"Target intake must be active\")\n    \n    # Check if the voided intake is already marked as duplicate of another intake\n    if voided_intake.duplicate_of_intake_id is not None:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST, detail=\"Intake is already marked as duplicate\")\n    \n    # Reassign medical events\n    medical_events_updated = db.query(MedicalEvent).filter(MedicalEvent.intake_id == intake_id).update({MedicalEvent.intake_id: payload.target_intake_id})\n    \n    # Reassign foster placements\n    foster_placements_updated = db.query(FosterPlacement).filter(FosterPlacement.intake_id == intake_id).update({FosterPlacement.intake_id: payload.target_intake_id})\n    \n    # Update the voided intake\n    voided_intake.status = \"voided\"\n    voided_intake.duplicate_of_intake_id = payload.target_intake_id\n    voided_intake.voided_reason = payload.voided_reason\n    voided_intake.voided_at = datetime.utcnow()\n    voided_intake.voided_by_user_id = current_user.id if current_user else None\n    \n    # Add audit log entry\n    audit_entry = AuditLog(\n        user_id=current_user.id if current_user else None,\n        action=\"void_duplicate\",\n        entity_type=\"intake\",\n        entity_id=intake_id,\n        details=f\"Voided intake {intake_id} as duplicate of {payload.target_intake_id}. Reason: {payload.voided_reason}\"\n    )\n    db.add(audit_entry)\n    \n    db.commit()\n    \n    return VoidDuplicateIntakeResponse(\n        message=\"Intake successfully voided and related records reassigned\",\n        voided_intake_id=intake_id,\n        reassigned_medical_events_count=medical_events_updated,\n        reassigned_foster_placements_count=foster_placements_updated\n    )"
    }
  ]
